start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:draw-the-task-map-of-one-page with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and message_ids [\"m1\"] and first_page false."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the arrivals and the jobs are the person's own rows, in whatever form their store keeps them, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:draw-the-task-map-of-one-page" with store, the message ids of one page, and first_page true only on the first page.
3. The first run makes the indexes once and proves them on the example page; every attempt must come out as the prove step says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run reads the map from the indexes and never the words of an arrival or a job.
